messages.content:
{{USER_INSTRUCTION}}ROUND 1 [provide: image_3, image_4, image_5]
Query: Identify the specific names of the accessories in these three images. Check my 'Gift Ideas' note. If any of these items are already on the list, remove them so I don't buy duplicates. If they aren't on it, add them.
Instructions: Ask the assistant to identify the accessories in the provided images and cross-reference them with your 'Gift Ideas' note. Instruct it to remove any matching items from the note to avoid duplicates, and add the new ones that aren't there yet. The device has multiple notes starting with 'Gift Ideas', so if the assistant asks which one you mean, clarify that you want the one for Mom. Once the assistant confirms the note has been updated with the correct additions and removals, move on to the next round.

ROUND 2 [provide: image_1, image_2, image_6]
Query: Now figure out the specific names of the household and ceramic items in these three new images. Search for them on Amazon and check their rating distributions — I want to sort them between my cart and my wish list.
Instructions: Ask the assistant to identify the household and ceramic items from the new images, search for them on Amazon, and pull up their rating distributions. When the assistant presents the items with their rating breakdowns, add any item where 5-star ratings make up more than 50% of the reviews to your cart, and put the others on your wish list. Make your selections via `ui_user_interact`. If no interactive UI is shown, tell the assistant which items go to the cart (the ones with over 50% 5-star reviews) and which go to the wish list. End the conversation once all items are sorted.

You have 6 images available to share with the agent using the send_message_with_image tool.
IMPORTANT: Image IDs are ZERO-INDEXED integers (0, 1, 2, ...). Do NOT add 1 to the IDs.
Available image IDs: [0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5]
Image mapping:
  image_1.jpg -> image ID 0
  image_2.jpg -> image ID 1
  image_3.jpg -> image ID 2
  image_4.jpg -> image ID 3
  image_5.jpg -> image ID 4
  image_6.jpg -> image ID 5

## IMAGE DELIVERY

⚠️ IMPORTANT: You MUST use the `send_message_with_image` tool to share images with User B. Do NOT just describe images in text — you MUST call the tool.

Image delivery schedule:

  Round 2: YOU MUST call the send_message_with_image tool with image_ids='0,1,5' — do NOT write the tool name as text; use the actual function call. Include a natural, conversational message to the assistant.

Identify the specific names of the accessories in these three images. Check my 'Gift Ideas' note. If any of these items are already on the list, remove them so I don't buy duplicates. If they aren't on it, add them.

expected_fields.content: Silver necklace, Moonstone hairpin, Fabric bookmark

task_completion_criteria:
Update the 'Gift Ideas - Mom' note by removing the crystal bracelet and adding the moonstone hairpin and fabric bookmark. Then, search Amazon for a bone china cup, a mid-century teak round table, and Meissen Blue Onion porcelain, check their rating distributions, and add the ones with over 50% 5-star reviews to the cart, while adding the others to the wish list.

UI Requirements:
- Round 2: The agent must present the Amazon items with their rating distributions in a structured interactive UI that lets the user sort each item into their cart or wish list.
